releaseNotes: Added topology-driven canonical LAD columns/pitch with branch-aware automatic downstream reflow and an explicit Reflow Rung command.
LAD edit commits now snap to logical columns while FBD/free-placement networks retain their existing coordinates; downstream reflow is one Undo/Redo transaction.

Classified 15-minute Master REST identity refreshes for the same physical device and verified runtime-owned Fast Autoscale bank as a no-op, preventing unnecessary selector ISDU/remap work and preserving MAX polling.

Preserved committed Product/Vendor presentation, IODD/Configured Device UI and logo/PNG state on all same-physical-device verified background refreshes, including non-Fast-Bank devices such as P1 SMC; only real identity changes, stale committed Fast Banks or incompatible PDO geometry retain fail-safe remap.

en: Added canonical LAD logical columns and engineering pitch with branch-aware downstream reflow and Reflow Rung.
LAD topology edits reflow only on commit; FBD free placement is unchanged and Undo/Redo restores the complete edit transaction.
Same-device verified Fast Autoscale runtime changes now end as MASTER_REST_IDENTITY_RUNTIME_OWNED_NOOP, skipping selector ISDU/remap and preserving MAX polling.

All same-physical-device verified background refreshes now preserve Product/Vendor presentation, IODD/Configured Device UI and logo/PNG, including non-Fast-Bank devices such as P1 SMC; real identity changes, stale Fast Banks or incompatible PDO geometry still use fail-safe recovery.
ko: 브런치를 인식하는 LAD 표준 논리 컬럼/엔지니어링 피치와 후행 자동 재배치, Reflow Rung 기능을 추가했습니다.
LAD 토폴로지 편집은 Commit 시에만 재배치하며 FBD 자유배치는 유지하고 Undo/Redo가 전체 편집 트랜잭션을 복원합니다.
동일 장치의 검증된 Fast Autoscale Runtime 변경은 MASTER_REST_IDENTITY_RUNTIME_OWNED_NOOP로 종료하여 Selector ISDU/Remap을 건너뛰고 MAX Polling을 유지합니다.
동일 물리 장치의 검증된 Background Refresh는 P1 SMC처럼 Fast Bank가 없는 장치도 Product/Vendor 표시, IODD/Configured Device UI, Logo/PNG를 보존하며 실제 장치 교체, stale Fast Bank 또는 호환되지 않는 PDO geometry만 기존 Fail-safe 복구 경로를 사용합니다.
ja: ブランチ対応の LAD 標準論理列/エンジニアリングピッチ、下流自動リフロー、Reflow Rung を追加しました。
LAD トポロジ編集は Commit 時のみリフローし、FBD の自由配置は維持され、Undo/Redo は編集トランザクション全体を復元します。
同一デバイスの検証済み Fast Autoscale Runtime 変更は MASTER_REST_IDENTITY_RUNTIME_OWNED_NOOP として終了し、Selector ISDU/Remap を省略して MAX Polling を維持します。

同一物理デバイスの検証済み Background Refresh は、P1 SMC のように Fast Bank を持たないデバイスでも Product/Vendor 表示、IODD/Configured Device UI、Logo/PNG を保持し、実デバイス交換、stale Fast Bank、または互換性のない PDO geometry のみ既存の Fail-safe 回復経路を使用します。
zh-CN: 新增支持分支的 LAD 标准逻辑列/工程间距、下游自动重排以及 Reflow Rung。
LAD 拓扑编辑仅在提交时重排；FBD 自由布局保持不变，Undo/Redo 可恢复完整编辑事务。
同一设备且已验证的 Fast Autoscale Runtime 变化现在以 MASTER_REST_IDENTITY_RUNTIME_OWNED_NOOP 结束，跳过 Selector ISDU/Remap 并保持 MAX Polling。
同一物理设备且已验证的 Background Refresh（包括 P1 SMC 这类没有 Fast Bank 的设备）会保留 Product/Vendor 显示、IODD/Configured Device UI 和 Logo/PNG；只有真实设备更换、过期 Fast Bank 或不兼容的 PDO geometry 才走原有 Fail-safe 恢复路径。
de: Kanonische LAD-Logikspalten und Engineering-Pitch mit branch-bewusstem Downstream-Reflow sowie Reflow Rung wurden ergänzt.
LAD-Topologieänderungen werden nur beim Commit neu angeordnet; freie FBD-Platzierung bleibt unverändert und Undo/Redo stellt die gesamte Edit-Transaktion wieder her.
Verifizierte Fast-Autoscale-Runtime-Änderungen desselben Geräts enden als MASTER_REST_IDENTITY_RUNTIME_OWNED_NOOP, wodurch Selector-ISDU/Remap übersprungen und MAX Polling erhalten wird.

Verifizierte Background-Refreshes desselben physischen Geräts erhalten Product/Vendor-Darstellung, IODD/Configured Device UI und Logo/PNG auch bei Geräten ohne Fast Bank wie P1 SMC; nur echte Gerätewechsel, stale Fast Banks oder inkompatible PDO-Geometrie verwenden den Fail-safe-Recovery-Pfad.
es: Se añadieron columnas lógicas y pitch de ingeniería canónicos para LAD, reflow descendente consciente de ramas y Reflow Rung.
Las ediciones de topología LAD se redistribuyen solo al confirmar; la colocación libre FBD no cambia y Undo/Redo restaura toda la transacción de edición.
Los cambios Runtime Fast Autoscale verificados del mismo dispositivo terminan como MASTER_REST_IDENTITY_RUNTIME_OWNED_NOOP, omitiendo Selector ISDU/Remap y conservando MAX Polling.

Los Background Refresh verificados del mismo dispositivo físico conservan Product/Vendor, IODD/Configured Device UI y Logo/PNG incluso en dispositivos sin Fast Bank como P1 SMC; solo un cambio real de dispositivo, un Fast Bank obsoleto o una geometría PDO incompatible usa la recuperación Fail-safe.
